er_lcvp.desc: a steel landing craft, ramp at the bow; origin on the waterline, deck 6 above it

er_blood.desc: a pool of blood on the sand

er_surf.desc: thin surf running up the sand and draining back

er_whirl.desc: a dead sun inside turning arms of light

er_mg42.desc: an MG42 machine gun on its bipod, a belt running from an ammunition tin, facing along its yaw; clip fire shakes it and flashes the muzzle

bf_hedgehog.desc: a steel Czech hedgehog beach obstacle, rusty three-legged anti-boat barrier

bf_ammo_box.desc: an open ammunition box with cartridges

bf_wreck_willy.desc: a wrecked Willys jeep, doors torn off

bf_plank.desc: a long wooden plank (shoring, ramps, wreckage)

bf_climbnet.desc: a rope cargo net for climbing the bluff
